hypothesis: The routed 24905 companion hypothesis is rejected by the pinned client data and the native trace. Spell 24905 owns damage/stat effects, while 24907 owns the 5% cast-speed effect and its owner apply/remove path is observed. The apparent native deficit is produced by the WoWSims comparator multiplying cast_speed_multiplier by spell_haste_pct even though WoWSims reports spell_haste_pct as the already-composed total. Repair the comparator conversion and preserve native aura arithmetic.

Do not add a synthetic 24905 cast-speed handler, inject a hidden percentage, weaken acceptance thresholds, or alter the WoWSims request catalog.
Do not accept actor_30001, any other actor, Balance performance, or Magmaw 10N before an attributable matched canary and later raid evidence.
